Package grpcdc

Class Http2Transport

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.Http2Transport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Transport
public final class Http2Transport extends Object implements Transport
Cleartext/TLS HTTP/2 frame transport (RFC 9113, generated from http2-spec.rkt) over a TCP socket. The mirror image of oracle/bridge.mjs: a generated client can dial a stock gRPC server directly (grpc-java server, grpc-go server), and a front-end can terminate HTTP/2 for a generated server. TLS via dialTls (ALPN h2). HTTP/2 server endpoints must enable cleartext h2c upgrades / prior knowledge (stock servers do not all listen plain HTTP/2; tests use the Java/Go greeters). Client endpoints only.
